_doc: Copy to ~/.claude/tts-voices.json. Keys under 'repos' are absolute repo-root paths (longest prefix match wins). Values are a Higgs preset name (belinda, en_woman, mabel, vex, ...), a voice name from hooks/utils/tts/voices/ (without .wav), or an absolute path to a .wav with a sibling .txt transcript. 'default' applies to any repo not listed.
